description: The 'reversal curse' describes a model's failure to generalize from a forward mapping (A is B) to its reverse (B is A), hindering information extraction.

instances.assertion: The 'reversal curse' describes a model's failure to generalize from a forward mapping (A is B) to its reverse (B is A), hindering information extraction.
The 'reversal curse' is a documented phenomenon where models trained on a forward mapping (A is B) fail to generalize to the reverse mapping (B is A).
